card.name: Punctuation and links before patient-risk groups
card.fires_on: Sentence-ending periods or short linking words (with, particularly) in label text right before a statement about patient groups, such as the elderly, or patients with a given history or condition.

modes.label: Period before elderly sentence
modes.description: A period that ends a sentence, just before the next sentence begins about elderly or at-risk patients.
modes.example: These events can occur at any time during use and without warning symptoms<<.>> Elderly patients and patients with a prior

modes.label: Link word before a condition
modes.description: The word with after 'patients' in a contraindication, before a named condition or history.

modes.label: Particularly before a time period
modes.description: The word particularly after advice to watch the patient, before a stated high-risk period.
